en.name: Peak inspiratory pressure (PIP)
en.shortDescription: Peak inspiratory pressure (PIP) — highest airway pressure during a delivered breath, in cmH2O.
en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

Peak inspiratory pressure (PIP) is the highest airway pressure reached during the delivery of a breath by the ventilator. It reflects the combined pressure needed to overcome airway resistance and lung/chest-wall elastance; a rising PIP signals increased resistance (e.g. secretions, bronchospasm) or decreased compliance. In source data it is a single numeric value per patient-timestamp, measured by the ventilator. It is recorded in intensive care and anaesthesia for ventilated patients. It is reported in centimetres of water (cmH2O); some ventilators display mbar (1 cmH2O ≈ 0.98 mbar).

## Included Concepts

- *4101694 / 27913002 — Peak inspiratory pressure (SNOMED)*: the maximum airway pressure during a delivered breath.

**Note on units**: reported in **cmH2O** (`44777590 / cm[H2O] — centimeter watercolumn`, UCUM), the recommended unit, with a registered cmH2O↔mbar conversion (1 cmH2O = 0.98 mbar).

## Mapping Notes

- Map a recorded peak inspiratory pressure (PIP, Ppeak) to *4101694 / 27913002 — Peak inspiratory pressure*.
- **Not plateau, mean or PEEP**: plateau pressure (during an inspiratory hold), mean airway pressure and PEEP are distinct pressures in their own concept sets.

## Summary
**Approved.** Used in QI01 as second fallback code for the inspiratory pressure (4101694, after 4215838).

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI01 (Lung-protective ventilation in ARDS).
- CQL: all 1 concept(s) of the set are referenced in [`IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql?plain=1) ([4101694](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql?plain=1#L76); each ID links to its code definition).

## Decision trail
- 2026-01-12 · Sebastian Gibb (clinician): Priority information added to the QI01 mapping ([PEEP: 42527140 total measured > 4216746 setting > 4353713 generic](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L192); [Vt: 44782826 inspiratory > 4108448 spontaneous > 3012410 setting > 4029625 generic](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L198); [Pinsp 4215838 before PIP 4101694](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L196); rule in the [mapping notes](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L169)). — [QI commit 26ca861](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/commit/26ca861af085ba7c1f0d7f30ca2302eb417de259)
- 2026-02-11 · Jan Moringen (implementation): Inspiratory-pressure fallback implemented with the codes 4215838 (Pinsp) and 4101694 (PIP, mmHg→cmH2O). — [CQL commit 479c102](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/commit/479c102447d5851deaababa68ca1df55e955fbcc)
- 2026-08-20 · Maxim Moinat (Erasmus MC data engineer): Approved FiO2, PIP, Pplat (v1.1.0), Vt (v1.1.0), VCO2. — [DD review tab](https://indicate-eu.github.io/data-dictionary/#/concept-sets?id=301&tab=review)
